phase_name: Authority Evaluation Integration Independent Implementation Verification
summary: Phase 147N independently re-verified the Phase 147M implementation of AESIC-001 v1.3 (the Authority Evaluation Service integration surface) by reconstructing the contract's requirements from source before consulting Phase 147M's own report, inspecting production code directly, and authoring 64 freshly-designed adversarial tests (tests/test_phase_147n_authority_evaluation_integration_independent_verification.py) exercising real filesystem persistence, real thread concurrency, git-diff-based purity confirmation, and static import-graph analysis. Independently confirmed: src/pcae/authority_evaluation/ is byte-for-byte unchanged since Phase 147H (empty git diff); AES is the sole orchestrator with no leakage into Publication, Interactive Workflow, or the Registry adapter; Stage 1 is advisory/non-persistent; Stage 2 always performs a fresh evaluation and never trusts caller-supplied Stage 1 outcome content; idempotency, multi-generation supersession, AER immutability, post-AER/pre-pointer crash recovery, and concurrent-write safety all hold against real persistence. Discovered and documented one new Major finding not disclosed by Phase 147M (AESIC-N-01: AuthorityEvaluationRecordStore.read_canonical/read_record never validate a pointer's or record's own embedded package_id against the query key, so a filesystem-level cross-key pointer relocation attack is not caught -- not reachable through AES's own public API, a defense-in-depth gap only) and one Informational finding (AESIC-N-02: post-crash retry creates a second, content-equivalent AER rather than literally rediscovering the pre-crash orphan by compound key -- final state is still correct). Overall Verdict: AUTHORITY EVALUATION INTEGRATION VERIFIED WITH NON-BLOCKING FINDINGS. Recommends 147O (Authority Evaluation Integration Operational Readiness and Chapter Certification), ideally alongside or preceded by a small bounded repair phase for AESIC-N-01.
tests_added_or_updated: Added tests/test_phase_147n_authority_evaluation_integration_independent_verification.py (64 independently-authored tests: architectural leakage via ast import-graph analysis, evaluator purity via git diff since Phase 147H, AES ownership and forged-evidence rejection, Decision Template Resolution and Registry attacks, Stage 1 advisory semantics, Stage1EvaluationResult attacks, Stage 2 ordering, idempotency-equivalence matrix, compound-key path-traversal, AER corruption, canonical-pointer cross-key relocation (new finding), multi-generation supersession, real crash-injection recovery, real thread concurrency, disclosure-only/non-gating checks, CHGR citation-only boundary, readiness package constraints, workflow integration surface, error taxonomy distinctness, and read-only diagnostics). The existing 242 Phase 147G/147H/147M tests were re-run in combination (306 passed together) and the full 4391-test fast_green baseline was re-run unchanged.
